What's your return and refund policy?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Our return policy varies by product type. Here's how it works:
Mattresses, Toppers & Foundations:
You must try the product for at least 30 days after delivery before requesting a return.
Returns are accepted within the sleep trial period (100 nights or 1 year, depending on the product).
There's a $99 return fee per mattress.
Photographic documentation is required and subject to review.
Shipping and In-Home Delivery & Setup fees are non-refundable.
Bedding, Pillows & Protectors:
Most items have a 100-day trial period (30 days for some items like throws and dog beds).
You'll need to contact us for a Return Authorization and we'll provide a prepaid shipping label.
Refunds are processed after we receive the product in good condition.
There are household limits (for example, 2 adult pillows, 1 of most other items).
General Notes:
Stained, unsanitary, or damaged items aren't eligible for return.
Items from promotions or "buy-one-get-one-free" offers aren't eligible for refunds.
Refunds typically take 2-3 business days for eligibility assessment, then 3-5 business days for bank processing.

We accept several payment methods:
Standard Payment:
Credit cards
Debit cards
Financing Options:
Affirm Financing - Offers rates as low as 0% APR for qualifying customers, with terms ranging from 3 to 36 months on purchases up to $17,500. There are no hidden fees or deferred interest.
Shop Pay Installments - For purchases between $50 and $3,000, you can split the cost into four equal, biweekly, interest-free payments. For purchases between $3,000 and $17,500, you can pay over 12 months with interest.
Progressive Leasing - A lease-purchase agreement designed for shoppers with limited or no credit history. Progressive buys the mattress and leases it to you, and you take ownership after completing payments.
Sika Health - Allows you to pay using HSA or FSA funds.
